d:
Take a second today. Look around. You made it this far. Through all the beautiful moments and all the difficult ones. And there is still so much ahead of you.
There is still beauty to experience. Still love to give and receive. Still places you haven’t seen. People you haven’t met. Moments that will make you laugh until your stomach hurts. Dreams that haven’t found their way into reality yet.
Life isn’t perfect. It never will be. But there is so much here. Right now. And so much still waiting for you.
